info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CustomAlerts plugin

get.description: Returns the computed alert value for each site linked to an alert for a past or current period.

parameters.name: idAlert
parameters.description: Alert ID to evaluate.

parameters.name: subPeriodN
parameters.description: Number of periods in the past to evaluate. Use 0 for the current day, week, or month.

200.description:
Alert values grouped by site.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns a single custom alert definition.

parameters.name: idAlert
parameters.description: Alert ID to fetch.

200.description:
Alert definition including the configured site IDs.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the custom alerts configured for the requested sites.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].

parameters.name: ifSuperUserReturnAllAlerts
parameters.description: Whether a super user should receive alerts created by all users.

200.description:
Alert definitions accessible to the current user for the requested sites.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates a custom alert for one or more sites.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Alert name.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Alert period. Allowed values: day, week, month.

parameters.name: emailMe
parameters.description: Whether to notify the current user by email when the alert triggers.

parameters.name: additionalEmails
parameters.description: Additional email recipients for email notifications.

parameters.name: phoneNumbers
parameters.description: Mobile Messaging recipients when the mobile channel is enabled.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric unique ID to evaluate, for example nb_uniq_visits or sum_visit_length.

parameters.name: metricCondition
parameters.description: Comparison rule to apply to the metric. Allowed values: less_than, greater_than, decrease_more_than, increase_more_than, percentage_decrease_more_than, percentage_increase_more_than.

parameters.name: metricValue
parameters.description: Threshold value to compare the selected metric against.

parameters.name: comparedTo
parameters.description: Number of prior periods to compare against. Allowed values by period: day => 1, 7, 365; week => 1; month => 1, 12.

parameters.name: reportUniqueId
parameters.description: Report unique ID in module_action format.

parameters.name: reportCondition
parameters.description: Optional dimension filter condition for report rows. Allowed values: matches_any, matches_exactly, does_not_match_exactly, matches_regex, does_not_match_regex, contains, does_not_contain, starts_with, does_not_start_with, ends_with, does_not_end_with.

parameters.name: reportValue
parameters.description: Value to match when $reportCondition is provided.

parameters.name: reportMediums
parameters.description: Delivery channels to use for notifications. Allowed values: email, mobile, slack, teams.

parameters.name: slackChannelID
parameters.description: Slack channel ID when the slack channel is enabled.

parameters.name: msTeamsWebhookUrl
parameters.description: Microsoft Teams webhook URL when the teams channel is enabled.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional alert description (max 255 characters).

200.description:
ID of the newly created alert.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns triggered alerts for the current user and requested sites.

parameters.name: idSites
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].

200.description:
Triggered alert entries for the current user and requested sites.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: CustomAlerts
tags.description: Exposes Custom Alerts API endpoints for managing alert definitions and reading triggered alert data. These methods let callers create, update, fetch, delete, and evaluate alerts for one or more sites.
